title: Proposal Refinement
description: Fork an immutable proposal or finalize a draft into a held committed snapshot. Refining an accepted proposal creates a draft amendment or cancellation proposal against its MediaBuy; the source remains accepted and unchanged.

action.description: revise creates a new draft snapshot with changed commercial terms. finalize MUST target a draft; it creates a new committed snapshot without changing terms and reserves inventory until its expires_at.

change_kind.description: Desired successor proposal. cancellation is valid only when the source proposal is accepted and attached to a non-terminal MediaBuy.

constraints.description: Hard requirements for every revised proposal. Keys are echoed in unsatisfied_constraints on partial or unable results.

total_budget.description: Inclusive bounds checked against commercial_terms.total_budget; currencies MUST match.

product_changes.description: Product IDs mapped to membership actions checked against commercial_terms.purchases. include requires presence; omit requires absence. The verbs match legacy get_products refinement.

alternatives.description: Request commercially distinct drafts by count. Every returned alternative MUST have a unique terms_digest; diversity preferences remain in ask.

ask.description: What the buyer is asking for on this proposal, or the cancellation reason for action revise. The seller returns a new draft proposal snapshot; this text never directly mutates the source proposal or MediaBuy.
